F-rnlr (Stams, Frg. 223): source-assisted reading.
Research readers reread these passages on the image: Pistoris p. 469 lines 1-11 (canvas 1), p. 467 middle lines (canvas 0), Martini p. 20 theses LXI-LXII and p. 21 (canvas 4), p. 19 foot (canvas 5), and the German letter 223-2r/2v (canvases 2-3) and endorsement 223-7r (canvas 6). Key names in the letter were also reread on neutral crops by two readers and settled on the image. All other printed lines rest on the image-only first reading.
Expansions are in ( ); [ ] marks text lost or supplied; (?) marks an uncertain reading. Boxes are native pixels (canvases 0-3 and 7: 7360 x 4912; canvases 4-6 and 8-11: 4912 x 7360).

Tugentsamen Frawen Margareta Schillbrig[...] zu   [surname: box 5500,960-6750,1130]
